lines.text: Peter stood up with the Eleven and said the men were not drunk, since it was only the third hour.
Peter said Jesus of Nazareth was put to death by nailing Him to the cross, but God raised Him.
Peter said David died and was buried, and his tomb was with them, but David spoke of the resurrection of the Christ.
The crowd was cut to the heart, and Peter told them to repent and be baptized for the forgiveness of their sins, and about five thousand were added.
The believers sold their possessions, shared with those in need, met daily in Solomon's Portico, and the Lord added to their number daily.
